overview.description: Crazy Pineapple is a poker card game that involves betting, hand rankings, bluffing. The game originated in USA and has become popular worldwide.

rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from your two remaining hole cards and the five community cards to win the pot.
rules.gameplay: Each player receives three hole cards face down. Preflop betting. Dealer deals three community cards (flop); betting. Each active player must discard one hole card. Dealer deals one card (turn); betting. Dealer deals one card (river); final betting. Showdown: best five-card hand using any two hole cards and five board cards wins.
keyRules: Three hole cards; discard one before the turn.
Five community cards (flop, turn, river) as in Texas Hold'em.
Standard poker hand ranking; best five-card hand wins the pot.
Blinds and betting rounds: preflop, after flop, after turn, after river.

phases.label: Initial deal
phases.notes: Deal three hole cards to each player face down.

phases.label: Pre-flop betting
phases.notes: Player to left of big blind starts; big blind acts last.

phases.label: Flop
phases.notes: Dealer burns one, deals three community cards face up.

phases.label: Post-flop betting
phases.notes: First active player left of dealer starts.

phases.label: Discard one
phases.notes: Each active player must discard exactly one hole card before the turn.

phases.label: Turn
phases.notes: Dealer burns one, deals one community card (fourth street).

phases.label: River
phases.notes: Dealer burns one, deals one community card (fifth street).

phases.label: Showdown
phases.notes: Best five-card hand from two hole cards and five board wins the pot.

ante.reason: Played with small and big blinds; no separate ante in standard Crazy Pineapple.

deal.reason: Deal is performed by the dealer; not a player action.

reveal_market.reason: This game does not use a market to reveal.

buy_market.reason: This game has no market purchase.

buy_stock.reason: This game has no buying from stock.

fold.description: Forfeit the hand and give up any claim to the pot; cards are discarded face-down.
fold.constraints: Legal during any betting round when it is your turn to act.

check.description: Decline to bet and pass action to the next player; no chips are put in the pot.
check.constraints: Legal only when no bet has been made in the current round (or you are facing zero to call).

call.description: Match the current bet to stay in the hand.
call.constraints: Legal when facing a bet; must match the full amount of the current bet or all-in.

bet.description: Put chips into the pot; in Pot Limit the maximum is the current pot size; in No Limit any amount up to stack.
bet.constraints: Legal when no bet has been made in the current round (or you are first to act and can open).

raise.description: Increase the current bet; must be at least the minimum raise (often the size of the previous bet or raise).
raise.constraints: Legal when facing a bet; must raise by at least the minimum; in Pot Limit maximum raise equals pot.

declare.reason: This game has no declare phase.

reveal_hand.description: Reveal your two hole cards at showdown; best five-card hand wins the pot.
reveal_hand.constraints: Legal in showdown; active players reveal in order (last aggressor first, or first active left of dealer if all checked).

award_pot.reason: Pot is awarded by the system after showdown; not a player-chosen action.

play_card.reason: Community card poker; no playing cards to a trick; actions are bet, fold, check, call, raise, and discard one before turn.

draw.reason: This game has no draw-from-stock action.

discard.description: Discard exactly one hole card from your hand before the turn is dealt; discarded card is removed from play.
discard.constraints: Legal only in the discard_one phase; each active player must discard exactly one card.

pass.reason: This game has no pass action.

bid.reason: This game has no bid action.

meld.reason: This game has no meld action.

go_out.reason: This game has no go-out action.

engine.deckDescription: A standard 52-card French deck comprising four suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades. Each suit contains thirteen ranks: Ace, 2 through 10, Jack, Queen, and King, providing versatile options for various card games.
engine.suitDescription: Four traditional French suits: Hearts (Cœur), Diamonds (Carreau), Clubs (Trèfle), and Spades (Pique), each represented with standard French card iconography and distinct color coding for easy identification.
engine.rankDescription: Standard thirteen ranks per suit: Ace, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, Jack, Queen, and King, where each rank has distinct value and meaning depending on the specific game rules and player strategies.
engine.dealPattern: 3 cards each, one at a time face down
